QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Barricaded 2
QuestInfo.0: Your only witness is gone, but complaining won't bring Zion back to life. Return to San Commerci and talk to Gilberto about the incident.
QuestInfo.1: Your only witness is gone, but complaining won't bring Zion back to life. You were about to head back to San Commerci to talk to Gilberto, but Claire stopped you. She senses something evil.
QuestInfo.2: Your only witness is gone, but complaining won't bring Zion back to life. You were about to head back to San Commerci to talk to Gilberto, but Claire stopped you. She senses something evil. And nearby, you found a new barrier!
